title: crm.account.check-sale-account, payload v1 (COMMAND)
description: Step 1 of the SALE saga (ADR-018 §5). order-service asks account-service whether this billing account may still be sold into. A COMMAND: exactly one intended handler, and a command nobody handles is a stuck sale rather than an unread fact. Destination: crm.account.cmd.check-sale-account.v1. Envelope aggregateType=order, aggregateId=sagaId=orderNumber. Re-asked here even though Submit already checked, because an account can be passivated between Submit and fulfilment.

orderNumber.description: The KR-12 number, which IS the sagaId (ADR-018 §3). Carried in the body as well as the envelope because no business decision may be made from anything outside the payload contract (ADR-017 §7.7).

accountNumber.description: The KR-11 billing account fixed when the draft was created. Not accepted from the browser at Submit — it is read from the draft.
